notes.title: Community Update #2 (Mar 18 2024)
notes.content:
Hello everyone once again! Last time we've asked the community to show us how they're staying warm this winter with Starri and we were not disappointed! Thank you じゃに(野村ひとみ), ヒ°ロシグ, Necolvjam, and more!

 We've seen even with people's busy schedule, some will still keep up short sessions everyday with Starri to keep a streak going (and to claim those daily mission rewards!)
 
 Alternatively others might dedicate hour long sessions to work up a sweat a couple times a week! Just be careful of yourself and to stretch so that you're not left with sore arms the day after!

 A couple of players on our discord will sometimes amp up the session with dumbbells, but please exercise caution! You won't want to accidentally throw your dumbbell across the room!

 We've also seen a few players share the fun with friends and relatives with 2P mode! You can also set the difficulty individually so one person can be playing Normal as the other plays on Expert.

 If you're too tired to play Slash mode, players have also used a chair to sit to play Catch mode.

Which sort of player are you?

Featured Streamer

チェリ子 Channel
https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/1763600720916623360/JRqdz2f6_400x400.jpg
(Only streams in Japanese.) A variety streamer who recently has playing a little Starri from time to time, so be sure to show your support!
YouTube

"Starri but it crowded"

ducky245 posted on our discord server this amusing challenge they tried by massively lowering the note distance and speed! Give it a watch and maybe try messing with the note customization options yourself.

Next Community Update: Developer Q&A

Have you ever wanted to directly ask a question to the Starri team? Now's your chance! For this Q&A we'll be featuring 506J, Starri's main chart producer. Leave your questions in the comments below and we'll pick our favorites for 506J to answer next community update!

Don't forget to use #starri when you post and follow us on X (Twitter) and Instagram!

notes.title: Nominate Starri!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43943633/e052f96d44b0f793801ed2d03e8fccb5c9e47cc9.jpg

Nominate Starri for Innovative Gameplay during the Steam Autumn Sale from November 21-28!

We designed Starri to be a rhythm game that makes moving to music feel natural and fun. It sounds obvious, but a lot of innovation went into making that possible. From the fact that you can use a webcam to detect your body movements without wearing a VR headset, to the way our content team crafts the beatmaps, everything is designed to help you just enjoy the rhythm. Not to mention being able to physically play with your friends together (we had a blast testing all the songs).

We're really proud of Starri, and hope to share it with more people through the Steam Awards. If you enjoy the game, please show us your love by nominating us  in the  Innovative Gameplay category!

notes.title: Starri's Steam Release is HERE!
notes.content:
Starri is out today, Oct 2! 
Get ready to immerse yourself into the rhythm of the music!

From rhythm game Indie favorites (conflict, c.s.q.n, destr0yer), Global Billboard Top Hits (Poker Face, Believer, Chandelier), and many hot hits from the Asian and Mandarin scene (Gira gira, Party Animal). You’ll find your rhythm to the songs that move you, and discover new artists in our 120+ songs library!

Each song comes alive with its own unique visual beatmap, carefully handcrafted by our beatmapper team to match the mood of the music. The visuals sync seamlessly with the choreography of the music, creating an immersive experience that engages all your sense.

What's more? Express your style with a range of outfits for your avatar! The choice is yours.

Get ready to step into the groove now!

Questions? Feedback?
Check out our handy FAQ  that we think covers most of the questions you'd have. Or feel free to find us on Twitter!
